title_angle: The hospital floor that does not exist
thumbnail_visual_story: A sealed elevator opens onto an unlit hospital corridor on the right, a lone adult guard reflected in its doors
facts: An adult hospital guard receives calls from a sealed floor.
The elevator records visits that nobody remembers.
A familiar voice asks the guard to break the final rule.

title_angle: The road that returns to the same tree
thumbnail_visual_story: A crooked tree beside a deserted wet road on the right casts a shadow facing a lone adult driver
facts: An adult driver follows a detour into a silent forest.
The same marked tree appears after every turn.
The road remembers a passenger the driver never picked up.

title_angle: The room behind the rented bedroom
thumbnail_visual_story: A locked bedroom door on the right leaks pale light beneath its frame inside a decaying empty house
facts: An adult tenant hears furniture moving behind a wall.
The landlord insists the building has no adjoining room.
Each night a new item from the tenant’s childhood appears.

title_angle: The passenger on the last train
thumbnail_visual_story: An empty train carriage on the right contains one reflected passenger in a rain-streaked window
facts: An adult commuter boards the final train after midnight.
Stations pass with names erased from every map.
A silent passenger knows which stop the commuter must avoid.

thumbnail_visual_story: An old radio on the right glows beside a rain-covered window, its reflection showing a distant silhouette
facts: An adult repairer restores an abandoned shortwave radio.
Its broadcasts describe events one day before they happen.
The next voice on the frequency is the repairer’s own.

thumbnail_visual_story: A lighthouse window on the right frames an impossible pale beam rising from dark ocean waves
facts: An adult lighthouse keeper sees a beam rising from underwater.
The logbook contains entries written in the keeper’s handwriting.
A vessel approaches with every cabin window dark.

thumbnail_visual_story: A cracked mirror on the right reflects a lit doorway while the surrounding empty bedroom remains dark
facts: An adult insomniac notices a delayed reflection.
The reflection starts moving while the room remains still.
Covering the mirror only moves the sound to another room.

title_angle: The village that locks its doors at dusk
thumbnail_visual_story: A village gate on the right stands half open beneath hanging lanterns, with a solitary shadow beyond
facts: An adult visitor arrives in a remote fictional village.
Every resident bolts the door before the final bell.
Someone outside speaks with the voices of absent neighbors.

title_angle: The tape with a missing final minute
thumbnail_visual_story: A cassette recorder on the right rests beside a single illuminated chair in a dark abandoned archive
facts: An adult archivist catalogues unmarked recordings.
A recurring voice describes the archive’s present layout.
Every tape ends just before someone enters the room.

thumbnail_visual_story: A basement staircase on the right descends into impossible depth beneath a single flickering bulb
facts: An adult caretaker discovers a staircase beneath a locked basement.
The building plans show solid ground below the final landing.
Footsteps answer from one floor deeper each time.

title_angle: The visitor outside the snowbound cabin
thumbnail_visual_story: A frosted cabin window on the right reveals a tall indistinct shadow beyond deep untouched snow
facts: An adult weather researcher is isolated by a blizzard.
A visitor knocks without leaving footprints.
The radio warns never to answer a voice that sounds familiar.

title_angle: The doorbell that rings from inside
thumbnail_visual_story: A doorbell camera on the right shows an empty porch while an interior doorway holds a faint silhouette
facts: An adult homeowner receives doorbell alerts from inside the house.
The recordings are stamped several minutes in the future.
The final notification shows the homeowner standing outside.
